General education courses never go in a block, so no blocks are recorded. The certificate's own requirements, total units, outcomes and careers do not appear in the text.
The HUMN courses from the closed list appear only as Cal-GETC Area 3B options. A reviewer should locate the Humanities program page in the 2026-2027 catalog to record the certificate's requirements.
